desc: Ideate approaches and select the prefix-length sweep with a value-ordered max Fenwick tree.

Implement the prefix-length sweep solution: read input, compress A values, sort queries by R, maintain a max Fenwick tree over value ranks, process A left to right updating rank(a) with 1 + query(rank(a)-1), answer each query by query(bisect_right(vals, X)), and print answers in original order.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases (duplicates, X not present in A, R=1, all equal values).
